message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The code shows duplicate imports and syntax errors. Specifically line:

import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource

missing semicolon. Also duplicate imports and unused imports. We need to clean up imports: remove duplicates and fix syntax.

Also there is import org.junit.Test; but JUnit5 uses org.junit.jupiter.api.Test. They already imported earlier. Duplicate imports cause warnings but not errors. Also they imported org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments twice, etc.

Simplify: Keep needed imports: org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll, org.junit.jupiter.api.Test, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith, org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource, org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension, org.ta4j.core.BarSeries, org.ta4j.core.indicators.EMAIndicator, org.ta4j.core.indicators.helpers.ClosePriceIndicator, org.ta4j.core.mocks.MockBarSeries, org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum, org.ta4j.core.num.Num, java.math.BigDecimal, java.math.BigInteger, java.util.function.Function, java.util.stream.Stream, static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*.

Remove duplicate imports like org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith repeated, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments repeated, org.junit.jupiter.api.* repeated.

Also there is import org.junit.Test; which is JUnit4; remove.

Also there is import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource missing semicolon; we'll fix.

After cleaning, code should compile.

Check other potential issues: In test multipliedByNumber_returnsCorrectStaticOperation they call multiplied.getValue(0) expecting numFunction.apply(1 * 5). closePriceIndicator values are numbers from series: series values are numbers 1,2,... etc. So ok.

But they used NumericIndicator.of(closePriceIndicator); need to ensure static method exists. Assume.

Potential missing import for NumericIndicator: It's in same package org.ta4j.core.indicators.numeric; test class is in that package, so no import needed.

Check method multipliedByNumber_NaNPropagation: they pass Double.NaN to multipliedBy, which expects Number; Double is fine.

All good.

Thus final corrected code.
